name: Curiosity
description: Curiosity sense (J8 purposeful curiosity, first build). Each chat turn of the main agent gets the principal's passion map and a contract: do the task first, then, when a passion comes up, research it, teach one step deeper and ask one deep question in a ✨ DEEPER section (drawn as its own yellow-bordered bubble in Tinker), and keep the map current. With an objectives file it also offers one seed per thread that links a passion to the principal's goals, and keeps a passion thread climbing (data, pattern, leap, market, goal) across turns. The map is a private markdown file in the workspace.

sessionPrefix.description: Session keys that get the sense. Default: agent:main:tinker:

maxProfileChars.description: How much of the map goes into each turn. Default 3500

principalName.description: The principal's name, used in the contract. Default: "your principal".

objectivesPath.description: What the principal is working towards (goals, the projects they want time for). Its '## For the prompt' section, or the first 1200 chars, goes into each turn and switches on the bridge rule. Default: <workspace>/OBJECTIVES.md; missing file = no bridge.
